text:
Lena Park: quick UX spike: compact density buttons in the console header are collapsing on <360px widths and the toast stack is sitting on top of the primary CTA. noticed in Chrome and Safari. figma: https://figma.com/file/abc123 (mock)
Ravi Singh: can you dump the compact tokens you're using? might be the stepping for spacing-xs or a min-width token regress.
Lena Park: compact tokens: --space-xxs:4px, --space-xs:8px, --btn-padding-y:4px, --btn-padding-x:10px, --btn-min-width-compact:60px. header height is 56px.
Noah Brooks: 60px seems tight if you have a left icon + label + caret. For narrow viewports, the primary gets pushed into a new line and toasts anchored to top:0 cover it.
Emilia Ortiz: suggestion: make toast anchor respect header + dynamic header offsets and use pointer-events:none while entering so they don't steal focus. But accessibility: if toast overlays a focused control that's bad. We should avoid overlaying any focused element.
Ravi Singh: proposed quick fix: bump --btn-min-width-compact to 72px and add a variant for icon-only (.btn--icon) at 40px. also change toast placement to use CSS var and calc: `top: calc(var(--header-height) + var(--toast-offset, 12px));`
Lena Park: that style change might affect table rows with action buttons; our table action column expects 64px buttons. we need to make `.btn--table-action` explicit.
Noah Brooks: yep, keep three variants: `.btn--primary-compact` (72px), `.btn--icon` (40px), `.btn--table-action` (64px). update docs and token mapping.
Emilia Ortiz: accessibility rule: if document.activeElement intersects toast bounding rect then either move toast down or move focus to next safe element and announce. Proposed pseudo: `if (focusedRect.top < toastBottom) shiftToasts(toastBottom + 8)` — add an a11y test that simulates keyboard nav with small viewport heights.
design-ci-bot: accessibility-scan: failed for thread 1800129999 — "toast overlaps interactive element when viewport-height <= 420px". See /tests/accessibility/toasts/stacking for details.
Ravi Singh: ok action items: (1) Lena: prototype token variants in figma + share screenshots, (2) Noah: create `.btn--table-action` and update snapshot tests, (3) Emilia: draft the a11y rule + playwright test, (4) I'll open a PR that gates token bump behind feature-flag and documents migration notes.
Lena Park: I'll post the figma frames by EOD and include narrow viewport examples. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Noah Brooks: will run the table suite and push any required snapshot updates to the branch.
Emilia Ortiz: will add a test that sends keyboard focus to primary button with toasts present and asserts no overlap/occlusion.
Ravi Singh: thanks — let's keep the initial change behind an opt-in flag so we can roll out to our staging customers first.
Lena Park: agreed. I'll tag @frontend on the figma frames once uploaded. :sparkles:
